title: Python production DODAG admits peer-asserted root and unbound source IID
description: The signed authenticated SCHC DIO vector consumer manually enforces IPv6 source IID == signer IID and root DODAGID == AddrForKey(root signer), but production DodagState.process_authenticated_dio does not. Link issuance expected_role='root' only checks rank 256, so any pinned peer can sign a rank-256 DIO for a victim DODAGID; source/signature identity is likewise not bound in production. Move both checks into owner-issued production authenticated-DIO admission and add root/peer impersonation, wrong-source, rekey, and vector-backed tests.
